title: RS 457 Supersport (Explorer Pack)
description: The Aprilia RS 457 Supersport (Explorer Pack) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, positioned in the Urban Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
